personal_identity.professional_summary: Final-year cybersecurity student based in Gujarat, India, with hands-on focus on defensive security engineering, SOC alert monitoring, and incident investigation. Rather than relying on purely theoretical study, I build practical open-source tools: ThreatForge (a SIEM log correlation platform mapped to MITRE ATT&CK), CyberNewsAI-Pro (a threat intelligence and CVE extraction aggregator), and DFIR CaseVault (a digital forensics platform enforcing cryptographic SHA-256 integrity and chain-of-custody tracking). Proficient in Python, Linux, FastAPI, React, and log telemetry analysis.

projects.name: ThreatForge
projects.title: ThreatForge — Security Monitoring, SIEM Log Correlation & Threat Detection Platform
projects.purpose: Simulate real-world SOC workflows by ingesting heterogeneous telemetry from auth systems, firewalls, and servers, normalizing logs into standard schemas, and correlating events against MITRE ATT&CK techniques.

mitre_attack_rules.name: Brute Force (Password Guessing)
mitre_attack_rules.detection: Detects rapid failed authentication bursts exceeding threshold within a rolling 5-minute window.

mitre_attack_rules.name: Password Spraying
mitre_attack_rules.detection: Detects single IP attempting authentication across multiple distinct usernames.

mitre_attack_rules.name: Compromised Credentials / Privileged Activity
mitre_attack_rules.detection: Flags off-hours administrative access, sensitive privilege escalation, and root account anomalies.

mitre_attack_rules.name: Network Service Discovery
mitre_attack_rules.detection: Monitors firewall telemetry for repeated denied connection attempts across multiple ports.

projects.name: DFIR CaseVault
projects.title: DFIR CaseVault — Digital Forensics & Incident Response Platform
projects.purpose: Enforce evidentiary rigor and cryptographic immutability during digital investigations with tamper-evident evidence tracking, chain-of-custody ledgers, and publication-ready PDF case dossiers.
key_features: Cryptographic SHA-256 baseline hashing on artifact ingestion using Python hashlib
On-demand integrity verification detecting byte-level tampering on disk without overwriting original baseline
Strict path traversal defense preventing directory escape via Path.is_relative_to and regex sanitization
Immutable append-only Chain of Custody (CoC) ledger recording all file ingestions, audits, and transfers
Non-executing artifact parsers (syslog, CSV network flows, JSON configs, PDF metadata, image EXIF, and safe ZIP TOC inspection without disk decompression)
Deterministic IoC extraction for IPv4 addresses, URLs, domains, emails, and SHA-256 hashes
Multi-source chronological timeline reconstruction
Publication-ready forensic PDF dossier generation with ReportLab NumberedCanvas dynamic pagination
9/9 backend Pytest verification tests and clean TypeScript/Vite frontend build
